named-query.name: ColetaCientifica.PorIdExpedicao
named-query.query: Select cc From ColetaCientifica cc Join Fetch cc.setor Join Fetch cc.pesquisador Where cc.expedicao.id = :id

named-query.name: Amostras.PorIdColeta
named-query.query: Select ac From AmostraCientifica ac Where ac.coleta.id = :id

named-query.name: Equipamentos.buscaSituacaoPorData
named-query.query: Select e From Equipamento e Where e.situacaoOperacional like :situacao AND NOT EXISTS ( Select ue From UtilizacaoEquipamento ue where ue.equipamento = e AND ue.dataHoraRetirada < :dataFim AND (ue.dataDevolucao IS NULL AND ue.previsaoDevolucao > :dataInicio OR ue.dataDevolucao > :dataInicio ) )

named-query.name: Expedicao.buscarPlano
named-query.query: SELECT e.planoSeguranca FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.id = :id

named-query.name: Expedicao.buscarAutorizacao
named-query.query: SELECT e.autorizAmbiental FROM Expedicao e WHERE e.id = :id
